title: Object Component
summary: Official Derivative overview of Object Components as the Component subset used to create and render 3D scenes in TouchDesigner, including cameras, lights, geometry, nulls, FBX/USD imports, shared-memory objects, and the ObjectCOMP Python class anchor.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs to distinguish 3D Object Components from Panel or Misc components.
Object Components are the correct family context for cameras, lights, geometry, FBX/USD scene imports, object nulls, handles, and 3D render hierarchy work.
For specific creation or parameter behavior, pair this overview with the individual operator card such as geometryCOMP, cameraCOMP, lightCOMP, environmentlightCOMP, fbxCOMP, or usdCOMP.
Use ObjectCOMP Class for Python behavior shared by Object Components, then use the more specific COMP class or operator class when needed.
